a.xlink:title: Prerequisite header file for GROMACS build.

Declares gmx::HostAllocationPolicy, gmx::HostAllocator, gmx::HostVector and gmx::PaddedHostVector, which are used to make/be standard library containers that can allocate memory suitable for transfers. Currently the only supported transfers using pinned memory are to CUDA GPUs, but other possibilities exist in future.
Declares gmx::ArrayRef.
Declarations for DeviceContext class.
Declares functions to manage GPU resources.
Declare functions for detection and initialization for GPU devices.
Declares functions for comparing views of vector-like data.
Declares real and related constants.
Describes test environment class which performs GPU device enumeration for unit tests.
Describes test environment class which performs hardware enumeration for unit tests.
Declares helper functionality for device transfers for tests for GPU host allocator.
Tests for allocators that offer a minimum alignment.
Declares gmx::PaddedRVecVector.

Declares common exception classes and macros for fatal error handling.

Basic types and macros used throughout GROMACS.
Defines assert macros customized for Gromacs.
Declares GMX_CURRENT_FUNCTION for getting the current function name.
Declare functions for host-side memory handling.
Declares common utility classes and macros.
